title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds OST - Into the Wilds (Main Theme Song)
author: Goldielou - VGM Watcher
description:
Composers: Ashton Mills, Peter Michael Davison / Orchestrator: Dora Kmezic / Performers: Ally Banayoti (vocals), The Purcell Singers (choir), Sarah Davison (cello, viola da gamba), Nick Pynn (guitar)

Can be heard in the Official Gameplay Teaser, in the Official Narrative Trailer, and on the starting screen.
This is a slightly shortened version (original track length: 3'36).
Game release: September 15th 2026 / Soundtrack release: December 3rd 2025
